tools.name: check_invention
tools.description: Check whether a complete invention document would load in a local Fyug, without playing it. Succeeds with {loadable, module_count, connection_count}; otherwise fails with the error a local load_invention reports. Pass json as a serialized JSON string of at most 64 KiB. Documents may define developme

tools.name: describe_example
tools.description: Inspect an exact playable-example ref returned by list_examples. Returns dependencies and assets while omitting the full internal graph; does not load or play anything. Fails explicitly when detail exceeds 256 KiB.

tools.name: describe_module
tools.description: Inspect one builtin module type: pass type with optional config. Omitted/null config inspects type defaults; supplied config uses creation's validation/defaults. Config limit: 16 KiB; response payload: 64 KiB. Errors are explicit.

tools.name: describe_module_types
tools.description: List the builtin module type names in alphabetical order. Defaults to a terse index; pass detail: full for default-config ports/controls and explicit per-type errors. Optional types filter accepts 1–64 exact names; unknown names fail. Payload limit: 64 KiB; narrow oversized queries. Use describe_mod

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Report what this server can do: it is not connected to a running Fyug and cannot play audio. The result carries the URL for installing Fyug locally.

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Discover the complete playable examples bundled with this release. Returns compact summaries and exact refs; does not load or play anything. Use schema_version: 1. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); optional source/id filters and opaque cursor; kind, when supplied, must be invention. Copy a returned ref

tools.name: play_preview
tools.description: Open a limited browser preview of a complete invention document: the piece plays in the user's browser after they tap Play, with a reduced feature set, and may drop out. Use it only when no local Fyug tools are present; when they are, play the piece with them instead. Pass json as a serialized JSON
